claims.statement: Switch uses a native checkbox input with an explicit switch role and aria-checked state.
The switch keeps supporting description in the accessible description relationship.
A bare switch renders no copy of its own so a host row's label is never duplicated.
The thumb follows a horizontal drag 1:1 and commits by release position; a pointercancel abandons the gesture.
A caller-supplied aria-labelledby survives to the native control, so a bare switch in a labelled row has an accessible name.
A switch renders no tick: the shared checked-state mark belongs to checkbox and radio, and on a track it reads as a defect.
The indicator sets touch-action:none so the browser cannot reclaim a horizontal drag that drifts off-axis, including one that ends outside the control.

component.purpose: Expose an immediate binary setting with an explicit switch role and calm state transition.
component.title: Switch

states.description: A bare switch inside a host row that owns the label, adopted by id.
The switch sits on the trailing edge for settings-row conventions.
